title: hYYa Digital Footprint Check
shortDescription: Bona okwaziwa izinhlelo zokusebenza, hlola izimvume, lungisa ngasese.
fullDescription:
Kumahhala ngo-100%: akukho ukuthenga ngaphakathi kohlelo lokusebenza.

Izinhlelo zakho zokusebenza zingazi okuningi kakhulu ngawe kunalokho ocabanga ngakho. I-hYYa Digital Footprint Check ikukhombisa lokho ezingakubona, lokho okunokufinyelela okukhethekile, nokuthi ungalungisa kanjani lokho, ngamagama acacile.

IZINYATHELO EZI-4 EZILULA
1. Footprint: ukuthinta okukodwa kuhlola lokho noma yiluphi uhlelo lokusebenza olungakufunda mayelana nedivayisi yakho, njengomkhondo wedijithali.
2. Sensitive apps: bona ukuthi yiziphi izinhlelo zakho zokusebenza abanye abangazibona, njengezinhlelo zokusebenza zothando, ezokholo, ezempilo noma i-VPN, nokuthi lokho kungathini ngawe.
3. Tracker: bona ukuthi yiziphi izinhlelo zokusebenza ezingafunda isikrini sakho, zifunde zonke izaziso, noma zivale idivayisi yakho. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezinezimvume ezingaphezu kweyodwa zalezi ziyamakwa, ngoba amathuluzi okulandelela asebenza kanjalo. Bese uvula irekhodi le-Android uqobo elibonisa ukuthi yiziphi izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenzise indawo yakho, ikhamera kanye nomboko wezwi.
4. Check-up: landela izinyathelo ezilula njengezibuyekezo, ukuqalisa phansi idivayisi masonto onke kanye nokuhlola amaphasiwedi avunyelwe ukubonakala, bese ubheka Izilungiselelo zakho ingxenye ngayinye ngesikhathi bese ubuyisela emuva ukufinyelela ongafuni ukukunikeza.

ISIKOLO ESISODWA SAKHO KONKE OKUNE
Isikolo sakho sobumfihlo, kwabayi-100, sihlanganisa lokhu kuhlola ubumfihlo okune ndawonye. Isikolo esiphezulu singcono, futhi siyakhula njengoba uqeda ukuhlola ngakunye. Faka iwijethi ukuze ubone isikolo sakho kanye nokuhlola kwakho kokugcina ngokushesha.

LUNGISA NAMI
Thinta "Fix them with me" bese uhlelo lokusebenza luhamba nawe ekulungiseni ngakunye, kancane kancane, likusiza ukuthola izilungiselelo ezifanele ngokushesha. Bese uhlola kabusha ubuke isikolo sakho sikhuphuka.

KUCACILE, KUZOLILE FUTHI KUTHEMBEKILE
• Ishadi lemibala ekhasini ngalinye: okubomvu kudinga ukubhekwa, okuphuzi kuwufanele ukwaziwa, okuluhlaza kulungile.
• Konke okutholiwe ngamagama acacile: isihloko esifushane, umugqa owodwa wokuthi kungani kubalulekile, nokuthi ungalungisa kanjani.
• Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezakhelwe ngaphakathi kudivayisi yakho azimakwa, futhi izinhlelo zokulawula kwabazali noma zomsebenzi zibizwa ngalokho eziyikho.
• Isitatimende esithembekile esithi "yi-Google kuphela noma umenzi wedivayisi ongalungisa lokhu" lapho kungekho ongakwenza.
• Isikhumbuzi samasonto onke noma senyanga sokuhlola futhi, uma ufisa kanjalo.

UKUBONAKALA NOMA USUKUSUSILE UHLELO LOKUSEBENZA
I-Android inika izinhlelo zokusebenza zenkampani ngayinye ikhodi ehlala injalo lapho uzisusa futhi uzifaka kabusha. Bona eyakho, nokuthi kungani ukusetha kabusha kwasefekthri kuphela okungayishintsha.

KUKLANYELWE UBUMFIHLO
• Ayikho imvume ye-inthanethi: uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukuxhuma noma kuphi, ngakho-ke akukho okuphuma kudivayisi yakho.
• Ayikho i-akhawunti, akukho ukulandelela.
• Kumahhala. Akukho ukuthenga, akukho ukubhalisa kwanyanga zonke.
• Umthombo ovulekile, ngakho noma ubani angabheka ukuthi lusebenza kanjani.

Hlangana nomsizi ongumseshi: usekhasini ngalinye futhi unokusikisela uma umthinta.

I-hYYa Digital Footprint Check iyingxenye yomndeni we-hYYa wezinhlelo zokusebenza ezibeka ubumfihlo kuqala.
releaseNotes: Lokhu kukhishwa kuqukethe ukulungiswa kweziphazamiso ezijwayelekile kanye nokwenziwa ngcono kokusebenza kahle.
